title: [v0.92][runtime][authority] Seal #258 authority store boundary slice
body:
Closes #258

## Summary
- seal raw certificate, lease, and fencing store access behind explicit authority/test access tokens
- make certificate, lease, and fencing access capability values non-ZST/private-field so ordinary external dev-profile non-test dependents cannot import fixture constants or forge access with unsafe transmute(())
- add and retain the governed authority store adapter facade plus published receipt view metadata for the #258 store-boundary slice
- preserve published-view classification for certificate, lease, and fencing store operations
- retain the PR-fast mechanical coverage classifier follow-up as non-authoritative proof for exact compile-fallout only
